title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval of a First Amendment to Firm Transportation Agreement with Gillette Company.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement.
